title: skills: filters.md Date Macros never mentions the {current_iso_week} period-key token #35391 added
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: ① skills drift owed by a merged PR: PR #35391 (#34938, merged 89364b49ff) declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`, and the seat files that card after merge. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/objectstack-query/`). Suggested-grade: p2 · the published query skill does not teach a filter token the platform now resolves, nor the refusal on date columns. Parent: #34938.
Dedupe: `current_iso_week` in open issues: #35394, #35395, #35396 (code cards, not the skill text); `filters.md skills`: #33875 (nested relations), #31112 (rule homes). None covers this.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：给 AI 用的查询技能说明会写上新的「本 ISO 周」周键占位符：它是什么、能用在哪种字段、用错会怎样。
- 为什么做：#35391 新增了 `{current_iso_week}`，技能说明还没写。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明；写错了重改即可，不影响运行。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

Since PR #35391, `{current_iso_week}` / `${current_iso_week}` is a period-key token (`PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS`) that filter placeholders resolve. `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`, section "Date Macros (declarative filter metadata)", lists the date macros only and says nothing about this token.

## Expected

In the "Date Macros" section of `filters.md`:
1. Add `{current_iso_week}` / `${current_iso_week}` as a period-key token, in a sibling list beside the date macros. It is not a date macro.
2. It resolves to the ISO week key `YYYY-Www`, in the workspace time zone, weeks starting Monday, with the ISO week-year at year edges (2027-01-01 is `2026-W53`).
3. It is for text week-key fields only. On a date, datetime or time field it is refused with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, exactly as the literal key would be. For date columns, use `{current_week_start}` / `{current_week_end}` or `this_week`.
4. A date dashboard default and `calendar.initialDate` refuse it. A text default accepts it and shows the resolved key. It must be the whole value, not part of a string.
5. In the scope paragraph, name `resolvePeriodKeyTokens()`, and say `resolveFilterPlaceholders()` covers all three vocabularies.
6. There is no last-week or next-week token. Don't imply one.

## Done when

- `filters.md` is changed as above, and the skills lint passes.
- Nothing else in `skills/objectstack-query/` contradicts it (search `current_week` and `week`).
